CORPUS SHAPE (40+ campaigns): extremely strong on FISCAL/NF525, SYNC-PERCEIVED, VISUAL-LAYOUT, and i18n-RAW-LABEL (render sweeps + raw-label regex sweeps + sync latency envelopes are thorough and repeated). Give full credit there — re-running them wastes the plan.

THE ACTUAL BLIND SPOTS the plan must attack, ranked by (daily_path × actionable/non-frozen):
1. data-correctness OF THE RENDERED NUMBERS per page ('bien calculé sur chaque page'): the corpus proved fiscal numbers at the DB/Z/API layer to death, but almost never asserted that the TOTAL/AOV/COUNT/BADGE actually painted on the screen equals it. Dashboard Ticket Moyen (multi-order AOV/rounding), history '3431/344-pages' count, KDS column counts + elapsed timers, OSS column counts, stock threshold badges, report period-sums = the richest empty cells, all NON-FROZEN.
2. error-state UX on operator surfaces: the encaissement modal no-session-CASH error modal literally does not exist yet (AUDIT_WAVE recommends a 409 'open drawer first' — NON-FROZEN, daily-path, single highest-value buildable fix). Plus per-widget API-failure UX on dashboard/history/reports/stock.
3. perf-optimization: a near-total NEVER column. Only FCP/LCP-on-load was measured (POS/KDS/OSS 3.4s, deferred P2). Bundle weight, N+1-feeding-a-page (history 3431 rows, dashboard KPI aggregates, stock availability tree), and heavy re-render (KDS/OSS poll redraw) were NEVER analyzed. This is code-readable statically (read-only friendly).
4. loading/empty-state on operator surfaces other than KDS: OSS load, dashboard KPI skeleton, history pagination load, Z-close in-progress, stock tree, reports — mostly NEVER.
5. a11y on POPULATED/MODAL/INTERACTIVE state: axe ran only on idle/initial load of ~8 surfaces; keyboard/focus-order was code-verified on the key modals (PaymentComponent, PosCounterCollectModal, KdsHistoryDrawer, KioskWizard — phase-l L5.3).
